name: io.github.WYRE-AI/eset-protect-mcp
title: ESET PROTECT
description: MCP server for ESET PROTECT's ESET Connect API - device, detection/EDR, vulnerability, patch, and user fleet visibility.

environmentVariables.name: ESETPROTECT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Email of the dedicated ESET Connect API user, created in ESET Business Account with the Integrations toggle enabled.

environmentVariables.name: ESETPROTECT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Password of the ESET Connect API user paired with ESETPROTECT_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: ESETPROTECT_REGION
environmentVariables.description: ESET Connect region: us (default), eu, de, jpn, or ca.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
